info.title: Hotel
info.description: The Hotel Booking API facilitates the reservation of accommodations, allowing users to efficiently manage travel plans. Through this API, consumers can create bookings for various hotel properties, providing essential details such as check-in and check-out dates, guest information, and room selection. This service is particularly useful for travel agencies, online travel platforms, and consumers seeking streamlined hotel booking processes. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with seamless integration to hotel reservation systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new booking in the system. Ensure that all required information is provided in the request body to successfully create the booking.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details for creating a new booking. This should include all necessary information such as booking dates, user information, and any additional preferences.

201.description: Resource created successfully, confirming the booking.

400.description: Invalid request parameters. Please check the input data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the booking details.

404.description: Requested resource not found. Please verify the booking ID.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Please try again later.
